verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS security and compliance platform that ingests customer data and runs AI agents (Fieldwork), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. The AWS `oneleet-ignore=true` tag and the RBAC-limited MCP access are related data-access controls, not controls over AI model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
